seo.description: Riverlight Church in Rivermont, NJ. Modern worship, practical teaching and a great kids program. Sundays at 9 & 11 AM.

contact.officeHours: Monday to Thursday, 9 AM to 4 PM

specialServices.title: Christmas at Riverlight
specialServices.note: Family-friendly services with candlelight. Kids programs at 3 and 5 PM.

hero.headline: You don't have to have it all figured out.
hero.subhead: Riverlight is a church for people who are curious, skeptical, hurting or hopeful. Come as you are.

welcome.heading: Church that feels like home
paragraphs: Riverlight started in 2016 with twelve people in a living room. Today we're a family of all ages who meet by the river every Sunday for honest worship and teaching you can use on Monday.

story: We believe church should be the most welcoming place in town. That's why you'll find great coffee, a safe and fun kids area, and people who are glad you came.
Our mission is simple: help people find and follow Jesus, together.

beliefs.title: Jesus changes everything
beliefs.text: We believe Jesus is the Son of God, who died and rose again so we could be made right with God.

beliefs.title: The Bible
beliefs.text: We believe the Bible is God's Word, true and trustworthy, and it shapes how we live.

beliefs.title: Everyone belongs
beliefs.text: No matter your story, there is a place for you at Riverlight.

beliefs.title: Better together
beliefs.text: Faith grows in community, so we do life together in small groups across the area.

staff.name: Marcus & Jen Holloway
staff.bio: Marcus and Jen started Riverlight in their living room. They have three kids and a very loud dog.

staff.name: Priya Natarajan
staff.bio: Priya leads RiverKids and makes sure every child is known by name.

staff.name: Dev Carter
staff.bio: Dev leads our worship team and runs the livestream.

staff.name: Alicia Gomez
staff.bio: Alicia helps people get connected to a small group and coordinates care for families in need.

ministries.name: RiverKids
ministries.description: Safe, fun and Bible-based programs for birth through 5th grade, with secure check-in.

ministries.name: Students
ministries.description: Middle and high school students hang out, worship and dig into real questions.

ministries.name: Small Groups
ministries.description: Groups meet in homes across Mercer and Bucks counties to share meals, study and pray.

ministries.name: Serve Team
ministries.description: Coffee, greeting, kids, tech, parking. Find your spot and make Sundays happen.

ministries.name: Rivermont Outreach
ministries.description: Monthly service projects with local schools, shelters and food banks.

ministries.name: Recovery Night
ministries.description: A Christ-centered recovery group for any hurt, habit or hang-up.

sermons.note: Every message, every week. Watch on demand or join us live at 11 AM on Sundays.

livestream.note: We stream the 11 AM gathering live every Sunday.

highlights.title: Friendsgiving
highlights.description: Bring a dish and a friend after the 11 AM gathering.

highlights.title: Serve Day
highlights.description: Teams fan out across Rivermont to serve our neighbors.

giving.message: Generosity changes lives, starting with ours. Thank you for supporting what God is doing at Riverlight.

visit.intro: Sundays at Riverlight are relaxed, upbeat and about 70 minutes long. Here's what to expect.

expect.title: Grab a coffee
expect.text: Our café opens 30 minutes before each gathering. First cup is always on us.

expect.title: Modern worship
expect.text: Our band plays current worship music, and lyrics are on the screens.

expect.title: Practical teaching
expect.text: Messages are about 30 minutes, rooted in the Bible and focused on everyday life.

visit.kids: RiverKids has a secure check-in at the kids entrance. Your child will get a name tag and you'll get a matching pickup tag. Arrive 10 minutes early on your first visit.
visit.parking: Free parking in the main lot. Look for the reserved first-time guest spots by the front doors.
visit.accessibility: The building is fully accessible, with reserved seating near the front.
